items.text:
Before I start this review I want to say that I dont think this game is passionless slop.

Ostranauts is a game which I sunk 14 hours into a playthrough for, with more hours in total from pirated copies. Yet ive really not seen anything too interesting, which is weird. Instead ive spent a bunch of time watching my character uninstall some scrap. Then dragging it back to my ugly (im aware it makes sense in universe but its still true) ship, flying back to a station, and selling it. I really dont have anything too interesting to spend my money on so I just put it back into my mortgage.

And thats a problem because scrapping ships seems to be the main gameplay element in this game. Yet its boring, at least its boring for the first 14 HOURS, none of which was spent fiddling with any controls. I never encountered a ship where there was, I dont know, crazy cultists, haywire defense systems, aliens, parasites, ANYTHING. Not even a room that was pressurized and so opening it will pull air in and hurt me. Oh, its a nuclear reactor, clearly uninstalling this unprepared will kill me, right? Nope, I just right click, press uninstall, and thats it. 

Thats what you do to everything, right click, press uninstall, some items can get damaged by uninstalling (like transponders) so clearly I need to prepare more and uninstall it more care- nope, its just rng, you just save scum it. Literally everything behaves the exact same and its so dull. Keep in mind im anxious as all heck, if there were one singular instance of ANYTHING happening id be scared for the rest of my playthrough.

This is related to the biggest thing lacking in this game, atmosphere. At least while on the vessels you are intended to scrap, theres nothing. The sound design is uninteresting. you never hear the ship creaking and threatening to break apart. You hear nothing. Sure it might be realistic but who cares about realism, realism serves to make the gameplay more involved or interesting, not to strip back interesting elements (insert the todd howard saying "oh starfield is realistic IRL you woudnt find anything on random planets).

The game is dystopian in name only. What happens when I dock, surely some guy holds me up for two hours unless I have money or "know someone", right? Nope, you dock perfectly fine with no holdups. Okay but clearly someones going to hold my ship hostage and make me pay a fee, right? Nope. You get charged very reasonable docking fees. You buy salvage passes to make sure you are legally allowed to salvage. So at some point a cop is going to run around and demand your salvage pass before tearing it up and saying that he will do you a favour and let you off this time (for a small fee, of course.) Nope. If you have a salvage pass no one bugs you.

Alright, so maybe not the corruption angle, maybe just the corporate greed angle (clearly something the game wants you to think). So I should start the game with just like, INSURMOUNTABLE amounts of debt from the corpos but nope, just your mortgage. When I fly back I should just be saddled with INSANE tacked on fees, fees for convenience, fees for administrative slop, fees that arent actually for anything. so on and so on. I'm not even being creative, thats just IRL ticketmaster. IRL ticketmaster is more of a dystopia than the fictional videogame. 

Also theres an achievement named 16 tons, and you get it from getting scrip, I dont have it. Why dont I have it. Scrip should really, be the DEFAULT METHOD of payment, the company store should be trying to OWN ME. Yet I get payed in normal legal tender I can use anywhere. Like whats the point.

This is all to say that despite the fact ostronauts claims to be a dystopian society, it really isnt, like theres really NOTHING dystopian here, other than some small annoying fees, sometimes. Like cmon, be a dystopia, not just like, capitalism but honestly less bad than right now for the most part.

Yeah sure maybe the game gets more interesting when you invest the time into building a torch reactor and flying far. But thats just annoying. The shipbuilding in this game is annoying and you have very little in game motivation to buypass it. You click to place where floors and walls should be and watch as your guy SLOWLY places them. Then if you would want that room to be survivable you need to install air and N2 and heating and cooling and all of that tied to thermostats and Blah Blah Blah. Its annoying and boring, and before you say "oh you just dont like building spacecraft" and true enough its not my favourite thing but at the same time ive played a large amount of KSP and enjoyed it. If this game just had an ACTUAL ship editor where I can place down what I want and I get an itemized list of what im missing this system would be WAAAY better. Also let me buy more floors and walls. 

You can just say "oh you have no patience" and sure, I don't. I've also put hundreds of hours into My Summer Car, a game that advertises itself as "not fun" I love stalker gamma, a game where getting a new weapon WILL take hours. I've played stalker mods that are extremely slow. But I enjoyed them because they gave me unique experiences, stories. The story of the brain scorcher raid. The story of me winning the rally. The story of me completing one quest (looking at you NLC 7, no one will no what that is). This game has given me one story (for like 99% of my playtime)

The story of docking with a ship, pressing right click to uninstall, and dragging it back.

Sure theres gigs and bounties, I BUILT MY ENTIRE CURRENT CHARACTER AROUND DOING THEM but they still just serve as supplementary income. Not to mention bounties are just, broken, you just show me a ship with no location info. I really cant do anything with this, apparently according to a guide I install a radar and sort through like, 100 ships, like really, is that exciting? 

Overall, ostronauts is tedious, boring, and not worth playing for most people. Thumbs down, I do not recommend
items.text_zh:
在我开始这篇评测之前，我想说我不认为这款游戏是没有热情的垃圾。

Ostranauts 是一款我投入了14个小时进行一周目游玩的游戏，加上盗版副本的总时长还要更多。然而我真的没看到任何太有趣的东西，这很奇怪。相反，我花了一大堆时间看着我的角色拆卸一些废料。然后把它拖回我那丑陋的（我知道这在世界观里说得通，但它确实很丑）飞船，飞回空间站，然后卖掉它。我真的没有什么太有趣的东西可以花钱，所以我只能把它又投回我的抵押贷款里。

而这是个问题，因为拆解飞船似乎是这款游戏的主要玩法元素。但它很无聊，至少在前14个小时里很无聊，这期间我完全没有摆弄过任何控制装置。我从未遇到过一艘有，我不知道，疯狂邪教徒、失控防御系统、外星人、寄生虫，任何东西的飞船。甚至连一个加压的房间都没有，打开它会让空气涌入并伤到我。哦，这是核反应堆，显然毫无准备地拆卸它会杀了我，对吧？不，我只是右键点击，按下拆卸，就这样。

你对所有东西都是这么做的，右键点击，按下拆卸，有些物品在拆卸时可能会损坏（比如应答器），所以显然我需要做更多准备，更小心地拆卸它——不，这只是随机数，你只要存档读档就行了。字面意义上的所有东西行为都完全一样，而且太乏味了。记住我焦虑得要命，如果哪怕有任何一个瞬间发生了任何事情，我都会在剩下的游玩过程中一直害怕。

这与这款游戏最缺乏的东西有关，氛围。至少在你打算拆解的飞船上时，什么都没有。音效设计毫无趣味。你永远听不到飞船吱嘎作响、威胁要散架。你什么都听不到。当然这也许很真实，但谁在乎真实，真实是为了让玩法更投入或更有趣，而不是剥离有趣的元素（插入托德·霍华德说“哦《星空》很真实，在现实中你在随机星球上什么都找不到”）。

这款游戏只是名义上的反乌托邦。当我停靠时会发生什么，肯定有人会拦我两个小时，除非我有钱或者“认识人”，对吧？不，你停靠得完全顺利，没有任何阻碍。好吧，但显然会有人扣押我的飞船当人质，逼我交一笔费用，对吧？不。你被收取非常合理的停靠费。你购买打捞许可证以确保你合法被允许打捞。所以到了某个时候，警察会跑来要求看你的打捞许可证，然后把它撕掉，说他会帮你个忙，这次放你一马（当然，收一小笔费用）。不。如果你有打捞许可证，没人会找你麻烦。

好吧，所以也许不是腐败的角度，也许只是企业贪婪的角度（显然是游戏想让你这么想的）。所以我应该以从公司那里欠下，就像，无法逾越的巨额债务来开始游戏，但不，只有你的抵押贷款。当我飞回来时，我应该被强加上疯狂的附加费用，便利费，行政垃圾费，实际上不为任何东西的费用。诸如此类。我甚至都不是在发挥创意，那只是现实中的Ticketmaster。现实中的Ticketmaster比这个虚构的电子游戏更像反乌托邦。

另外还有一个叫“16吨”的成就，你通过获得代币券来得到它，我没有它。为什么我没有它。代币券真的应该，是默认的支付方式，公司商店应该试图拥有我。然而我拿到的是可以在任何地方使用的正常法定货币。那有什么意义。

这一切都是为了说明，尽管Ostranauts声称是一个反乌托邦社会，它真的不是，就像这里真的没有任何反乌托邦的东西，除了一些小的烦人费用，有时候。就像拜托，做个反乌托邦吧，而不只是，资本主义，但老实说大部分时候比现在还不糟糕。

是的，当然也许当你投入时间建造火炬反应堆并飞得很远时，游戏会变得更有趣。但那只是烦人。这款游戏里的造船很烦人，而且你在游戏里几乎没有动力去绕过它。你点击放置地板和墙壁应该在哪里，然后看着你的角色慢慢地放置它们。然后如果你想让那个房间可以生存，你需要安装空气和氮气和加热和冷却，所有这些都连接到恒温器上，等等等等。这很烦人又无聊，在你之前说“哦你只是不喜欢建造航天器”之前，确实它不是我最喜欢的事情，但与此同时我玩过大量的KSP并且很享受。如果这款游戏只是有一个真正的飞船编辑器，我可以在那里放下我想要的东西，然后得到一份我缺少什么的逐项清单，这个系统会好得多。另外让我买更多的地板和墙壁。

你可以直接说“哦你没有耐心”，确实，我没有。我也在《我的夏季汽车》里投入了数百小时，一款自我宣传为“不好玩”的游戏。我喜欢《潜行者》GAMMA，一款获得新武器会花费数小时的游戏。我玩过极其缓慢的《潜行者》模组。但我享受它们，因为它们给了我独特的体验、故事。脑灼烧器突袭的故事。我赢得拉力赛的故事。我完成一个任务的故事（说的就是你NLC 7，没人会知道那是什么）。这款游戏给了我一个故事（在我大约99%的游玩时间里）

与一艘飞船停靠，按下右键拆卸，然后把它拖回来的故事。

当然有零工和赏金，我围绕做这些构建了我当前整个角色，但它们仍然只是作为补充收入。更不用说赏金只是，坏掉了，你只是给我看一艘没有位置信息的飞船。我真的对此无能为力，显然根据一份指南，我安装一个雷达然后筛选大约100艘飞船，真的，那很刺激吗？

总的来说，Ostranauts是乏味的、无聊的，对大多数人来说不值得玩。差评，我不推荐

items.text:
I just can't recommend getting it as is i am afraid. 

- The character creation sucks and is lacking features like presets and preset saving, which is not that major anyways, since there is one player model and no matter what it won't look anything like your character regardless of what you chose. It's not just a visual element, i just also dislike the element of randomness in a character creation.

- The UI is awful. In fact, i think this has got to be bar none the worst UI i've ever had to deal with in a video game and i've known the dos era. The information is disorganized, badly presented, implies insane amounts of clicking, the (too) many UI elements have little graphic/logical coherency, it's just a terrible, terrible time dealing with it all. Sure you *can* get used to it. But it was just bad design that stuck throughout EA when it should have been scrapped and redone. No UI/UX person on board and it really shows sadly. Whether it be inventory, character information, terrain or anything else, you'll be trying to enjoy yourself in spite of it the whole time. 

- The game's whole premise is to foster a "theatre of the mind" (dev's words, not mine), but the entire NPC interaction system is just terrible. It's essentially the sims type of interactions, with no logic or coherency in interactions. It all boils down just standing like a chimp in front of NPCs you wish to engage with and spamming dialogue options until you get high enough relations that they decide to acknowledge your existence and give you what you expect from them. At no point this system even attempts to make sense and you find yourself chaining nonsensical interactions. It is *so bad*.

- The graphical fidelity still gets in the way of readability on many objects and terrain. Beyond the aesthetic choice, it's just so low fidelity that one struggles to just make sense of what's on screen most of the time, and while in many games this sort of aesthetic can look pleasing when done right, this just looks unreadable, visually busy and unappealing.

- The performance, which was a big problem when i first picked the game up during EA, has been improved, although i'm still experiencing memory leaks and major slowdowns with very little on the screen = Automatic negative review. Those leaks were identified over a year ago, there was ample time to fix them.

- Feature wise it's rather rich in my opinion but content wise it's still rather devoid of content and sadly my understanding is that the dev simply had to push it out the door for lack of funds. In this game you'll find very little story-driven elements and hand-crafted narratives. What's there is good, but it's insufficient. For a sandbox game like this one, it feels very empty.

- The soundscape is still very bland, which for a game purporting to immerse you, is a big let-down.

- The game pushes you to hire a crew but the whole crew management/interaction gameplay (and especially performance, yikes) feels very janky. 

- Outside of the few handcrafted quests, the rest is typical sandbox busy work nonsense fluff and fetch-quests. Yawn.

- Jobs (non handcrafted quests) tend to be buggy and break, leading players to decide to just skip this entire area and to focus on other revenue streams.

So what's there to enjoy then?

- The ship piloting feels excellent.
- The scavenging, albeit repetitive as sin over time, is interesting.
- Ship building is interesting to engage with and has plenty of features to deal with.
- Exploring, although limited because again, world feels bland, empty and unfinished.
- There's some measure of hope for this game as it features a steam workshop integration.
- Murder investigations, if they weren't still as buggy, would be enjoyable as well.

My hope for the game is that the dev keeps working on it to finish what was clearly not yet cooked and ready to come out of the oven. On top of that, i hope for modders to address the main issues of this game, first and foremost the unforgivably bad NPC interaction system, and if at all possible, the UI.

As it stands though, do yourself a favor and do not engage until significant work is done on this title. It's a big let down for me and i'm sorry about it because i have a lot of respect for the Dev as a person, but this soured me on supporting their future endeavors a great deal.

恐怕我只能说，就目前这个样子，我实在没法推荐购买。

- 角色创建很糟糕，缺少预设和预设保存之类的功能，不过反正这也没那么重要，因为只有一个玩家模型，不管你选了什么，它看起来都完全不像你的角色。这不仅仅是个视觉元素的问题，我也很讨厌角色创建里的随机性元素。

- UI 糟透了。事实上，我觉得这绝对是我在电子游戏里遇到过的最烂的 UI，我可是经历过 DOS 时代的人。信息杂乱无章，呈现得很差，意味着要疯狂点击，那些（过多的）UI 元素在图形/逻辑上几乎没有连贯性，处理这一切简直就是一段糟糕透顶、糟糕透顶的体验。当然，你*可以*习惯它。但这本身就是糟糕的设计，在整个 EA 阶段一直存在，本该被废弃重做。团队里没有 UI/UX 方面的人，这一点很遗憾地暴露无遗。无论是物品栏、角色信息、地形还是别的什么，你全程都得在忍受它的同时努力让自己玩得开心。

- 这游戏的整个前提是营造一种“心灵剧场”（这是开发者的话，不是我说的），但整个 NPC 交互系统就是糟糕透顶。它本质上是《模拟人生》那种交互，交互中毫无逻辑或连贯性。一切都归结为像只黑猩猩一样站在你想互动的 NPC 面前，狂刷对话选项，直到关系值够高，他们才决定承认你的存在，给你你期望从他们那里得到的东西。这个系统在任何时候都甚至没有尝试过要讲得通，你会发现自己在一连串毫无意义的交互中循环。它*太糟了*。

- 图形保真度仍然妨碍着许多物体和地形的可读性。抛开审美选择不谈，它的保真度就是太低了，大多数时候人都很难看懂屏幕上是什么，虽然在很多游戏里这种审美如果做得好会看起来令人愉悦，但这个看起来就是难以辨认、视觉上杂乱且毫无吸引力。

- 性能问题，在我最初于 EA 阶段入手这游戏时是个大问题，现在已经有所改善，不过我仍然会遇到内存泄漏和严重的卡顿，而屏幕上几乎没什么东西 = 自动差评。那些泄漏一年多以前就被发现了，有充足的时间去修复。

- 就功能而言，在我看来相当丰富，但就内容而言，它仍然相当缺乏内容，而且遗憾的是，据我所知，开发者只是因为缺钱不得不把它赶着推出门。在这个游戏里，你会发现极少有剧情驱动的元素和手工打造的叙事。现有的内容是不错，但不够。对于像这样的沙盒游戏来说，它感觉非常空洞。

- 音景仍然非常平淡，对于一个号称要让你沉浸其中的游戏来说，这是很大的失望。

- 游戏推动你去雇佣一支船员，但整个船员管理/交互的玩法（尤其是性能，哎呀）感觉非常蹩脚。

- 除了少数几个手工打造的任务之外，其余都是典型的沙盒式忙碌工作、无意义的填充内容和跑腿任务。呵欠。

- 工作（非手工打造的任务）往往有 bug 并且会出故障，导致玩家决定干脆跳过这整个区域，转而专注于其他收入来源。

那么还有什么可享受的呢？

- 飞船驾驶手感极佳。
- 拾荒，尽管时间久了重复得要命，但挺有意思。
- 飞船建造玩起来很有意思，而且有大量功能可以折腾。
- 探索，尽管受限，因为还是那句话，世界感觉平淡、空洞且未完成。
- 这游戏还有一定希望，因为它集成了 Steam 创意工坊。
- 谋杀案调查，如果它们不是仍然那么多 bug 的话，也会挺有趣的。

我对这游戏的希望是开发者继续努力，把那些显然还没煮熟、还没准备好出炉的东西做完。除此之外，我希望模组作者能解决这游戏的主要问题，首当其冲的就是那不可原谅的糟糕 NPC 交互系统，如果可能的话，还有 UI。

不过就目前而言，行行好，在这个作品有重大改进之前别去碰它。这让我非常失望，我也为此感到遗憾，因为我个人非常尊重这位开发者，但这件事让我在支持他们未来事业方面大打了折扣。
需要处理的特性。
- 探索，尽管有限，因为再次强调，世界感觉平淡、空洞且未完成。
- 这款游戏还有一些希望，因为它集成了Steam创意工坊。
- 谋杀调查，如果它们不那么漏洞百出的话，也会很有趣。

我对这款游戏的希望是开发者继续努力，完成那些显然还没煮熟、还没准备好出炉的部分。除此之外，我希望模组制作者能解决这款游戏的主要问题，首先是那不可原谅的糟糕NPC互动系统，如果可能的话，还有UI。

不过就目前而言，帮自己一个忙，在游戏有重大改进之前不要碰它。这让我非常失望，我很抱歉，因为作为一个人，我非常尊重开发者，但这大大削弱了我支持他们未来项目的意愿。

items.text: "i started smoking at the age of 8 after working off feeble and other negative traits others like me born on this kleg are blessed with. my father a pirate my mother a shipbreaker i turned to hacking at 14, then quickly software engineering. working for the nsa, cia and any other 3 letter organization i learned what i needed and got out, at 20 i started wandering after getting my EVA cert. i was burned badly in a fire with some cargo once, fought a man over a scam on another and made a friend from helping form a gig, met a cop, got some street cred learned to gamble and set off with a Ryokka Tu Shuttle, just a little dingy but its a enough. ive never felt debt like this but its amazing how fast if forgot about it. only worried about my ship i fixed it ever 2 shifts, but quickly i found not having a license led to the law coming in. the first cop i killed well i didn't want to do it, truly i thought of him as a friend. .. .i liked him, imagine what id do to somebody i didnt like. the thought sent shivers down my back. i looted the maura intakes and a few other goodies and got out of there only after jetting any evidence. this happened a few times, in different ways over a few days with some pirates, cops some i liked some i didn't. now i have 400k a massive debt still but a ship built of the finest martials and can go so fast it will kill you from take off to max speed. i met a girl i fell for, she died and then me and the black market dealer fell for each other not sure how thats ganna blow up. slowing making friends as a person that has no humor and likes to tell jokes is well funny. also enjoying pain and being slow to heal is a joy. all together my short vision and bad hearing are the least of my worrys, ive quickly learned all the skills ive needed to build a space station if needed so i look forward to making friends and expanding. im hoping to have my own smaller ship well having them run the second larger one." its only been a few days in game 69 hours irl sense i started playing 10 days ago. it feels like neo scavenger with a top down Project zomboid like world but set in space and taking care of the ship is more the hassel then your person. my only compliant is audio. the music is great but theres long periods with none, which would be fine if we had louder or more living world souds or ambiet noise. also the ui clicks and checkmarks are about 2x louder then the game sound then put on a space helmet and do x16 work on a large item with checkmark sounds every second and it will make you wanna mute the game. i hope that detail only helps the dev. there are audio sliders and you will be sliding them often for diffrent vibes or leaving some lower and turning on background music of your own.
items.text_zh: “我在8岁时开始抽烟，因为要摆脱虚弱和其他负面特质，而像我这样出生在这个kleg上的人却天生就有这些。我的父亲是个海盗，母亲是个拆船工，我在14岁时转向黑客，然后很快做起了软件工程。为NSA、CIA和其他任何三个字母的机构工作，我学到了我需要的东西然后脱身，20岁时拿到EVA证书后开始四处游荡。我曾经因为一些货物在一场火灾中被严重烧伤，还因为另一场骗局和别人打过架，因为帮忙组建一个活儿而交了个朋友，遇到过一个警察，攒了点街头声望，学会了赌博，然后带着一艘Ryokka Tu穿梭机出发了，只是个小破船但够用了。我从未感受过这样的债务，但令人惊讶的是我多快就忘了它。我只担心我的船，每两个班次就修一次，但很快我发现没有执照会导致法律找上门来。我杀的第一个警察，好吧，我并不想那么做，我真的把他当朋友。……我喜欢他，想象一下我会对我不喜欢的人做什么。这个念头让我脊背发凉。我搜刮了maura进气口和其他一些好东西，在喷掉所有证据后才离开那里。这种事发生过几次，在几天里以不同的方式，和一些海盗、警察，有些我喜欢有些我不喜欢。现在我有40万，仍然是一大笔债务，但有一艘用最好的材料打造的船，速度快到从起飞到最高速能要了你的命。我遇到一个我爱上的女孩，她死了，然后我和黑市商人互相爱上了，不知道那会怎么炸开。作为一个没有幽默感又喜欢讲笑话的人，慢慢交朋友，嗯，挺搞笑的。还有享受疼痛和愈合缓慢也是一种乐趣。总之，我的近视和听力不好是我最不担心的事，我很快就学会了如果需要建造空间站所需的所有技能，所以我期待交朋友和扩张。我希望拥有自己的一艘较小的船，同时让他们经营第二艘更大的船。”游戏里才过了几天，现实中69小时，因为我10天前开始玩。感觉就像《Neo Scavenger》加上俯视角《Project Zomboid》那样的世界，但设定在太空，而且照顾飞船比照顾你自己更麻烦。我唯一的抱怨是音频。音乐很棒，但有很长一段时间没有音乐，如果我们有更响亮或更有生气的世界音效或环境噪音，那倒也没问题。还有UI的点击声和勾选声大约比游戏声音响2倍，然后戴上太空头盔，在一个大物品上做x16的工作，每秒都有勾选声，这会让你想静音游戏。我希望这个细节能帮到开发者。有音频滑块，你会经常滑动它们来适应不同的氛围，或者把一些调低然后打开你自己的背景音乐。

observations.evidence: theres long periods with none, which would be fine if we had louder or more living world souds or ambiet noise
observations.evidence_zh: 有很长一段时间完全没有声音，如果我们有更响亮或更有生气的世界音效或环境噪音的话，那倒也无所谓
